module.name: disttable
module.description: A statistical table computed by the module: the standard normal upper tail (z), the t, chi-square and F points for given upper-tail probabilities — the rows and columns you choose, one cell, row or column highlighted, and the rows and columns named for narration cues. No body.
module.aiSpec:
A DISTRIBUTION TABLE computed from the distribution itself — never typed by hand (no wrong digit, the same values on every slide and in the exam). Self-closing (no body, no @end). Values: z = the standard normal's upper tail P(Z ≥ z) (4 decimals); t, chi2 = the point whose upper-tail probability is p (3 decimals); f = the point F(ν1, ν2) whose upper-tail probability is p (2 decimals).
Parameters: • dist (select: z | t | chi2 | f, default t). • p (list) — the columns' upper-tail probabilities: t default [0.1, 0.05, 0.025, 0.01, 0.005]; chi2 default [0.995, 0.975, 0.05, 0.025, 0.01]; f: ONE value (default 0.05). • df (list) — the rows' degrees of freedom (t, chi2) or the second (denominator) ν2 (f): numbers and ranges, e.g. [1-10, 15, 20, 30]; `inf` adds the ∞ row of t (= z). df1 (list, f only) — the columns' first (numerator) ν1, e.g. [1-6]. • z (text, z only) — the rows, e.g. 1.5-2.4 (first decimal; the columns are the second decimal 0–9). A 16:9 slide holds about 12 rows at the default size and about 20 at `size: 0.6, pad: 0.04` — show the stretch the lesson reads, not the whole 0.0-3.4 table (render the slide to check). tail (select: upper | lower | center, z only) — P(Z ≥ z), P(Z ≤ z) or P(0 ≤ Z ≤ z). • mark (list) — highlight: [ROW, COL] tints the row and the column and sets the cell bold, e.g. t [8, 0.025], z [1.9, 6], f [12, 2] (ν2, ν1); `*` for one of them tints only the row ([8, *]) or the column ([*, 0.025]). • name (text) — places for cues: the row labels NAME-r<row> (row:#tt-r8), the column headers NAME-c<col> (col:#tt-c0.025), the marked cell NAME-hit. • digits (number) — decimals (default as above). nolead (boolean) — write .1841 instead of 0.1841. • size (number, default 0.72) — the cells' text size in em; pad (number, default 0.12) — padding above and below.
Example (the t-point for 8 degrees of freedom and p = 0.025, highlighted): <!-- @disttable dist: t, p: [0.05, 0.025, 0.01], df: [4-10], mark: [8, 0.025], name: tt --> script: [[mark: row:#tt-r8]]自由度 8 の行と，[[mark: col:#tt-c0.025]]0.025 の列が交わる所，[[look: #tt-hit]]2.306 です．

param.name: p
param.label: Upper-tail probabilities
param.desc: The columns (t, chi2) or the one p of an F table.

param.name: df
param.label: Degrees of freedom (rows)
param.desc: Rows: numbers and ranges, e.g. [1-10, 20, 30]; inf = the ∞ row (t). For F: ν2.

param.name: df1
param.label: F: ν1 (columns)
param.desc: F only: the numerator degrees of freedom, e.g. [1-6].

param.name: mark
param.label: Highlight
param.desc: [ROW, COL] — tints the row and the column, the cell bold; * for one of them.

param.name: name
param.label: Name
param.desc: Places for cues: NAME-r<row>, NAME-c<col>, NAME-hit.

param.name: digits
param.label: Decimals
param.desc: Decimals of the values (default: z 4, t 3, chi2 3, f 2).

param.name: pad
param.label: Row padding (em)
param.desc: Padding above and below the cell text.
